case_number: 2024 INSC 1020; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP (Crl.) No.1073 of 2023)

parties.respondent: THE STATE OF MAHARASHTRA AND ANOTHER

summary: Abetment of suicide under IPC s.306; time gap between alleged instigation (Mahalokadalat held on 17-Feb-2014) and suicide (20-Mar-2015); delay in FIR filing examined; standard: sufficient ground to proceed, not guilt determination; no immediate instigation evidenced; prosecution failed to establish active abetment; discharge application erroneously rejected by lower courts.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; discharge granted; impugned orders set aside; criminal proceedings quashed.
